en.value: Let (X,d) be a metric space and let B be a subset of X then if B is closed then B is also ______.

english.explanation: Let (X,d) be a complete metric space. Then, by definition every Cauchy sequence in X converges to an element of X. Now, B is a closed subset of X. Let {xn} be a Cauchy sequence in B. Then {xn} is a Cauchy sequence in X. Since, X is complete, we must have that {xn} → x for some x ∈ X but because B is closed, B must contain x i.e. x ∈ B. Hence, B is complete.
